dedupe_keys.name: wind tunnel benchmark dataset for wind farm control strategies on a three turbine farm

description: Technical University of Munich researchers publish 1,650 wind-tunnel tests of control strategies on a three-turbine scaled farm. The free Zenodo release uses CC BY 4.0 and provides NetCDF4 observations with an Excel test matrix. Synchronous measurements cover tunnel velocity, turbine states, control demands, power and high-frequency or filtered hub and tower loads. Strategies include wake steering, curtailment, pulse, helix and combined controls under steady wind directions. These experiments can calibrate reduced-order wake and fatigue components in wind-farm simulations. Related G6 data-farmconners-clwindcon-blind-test-wind-tunnel-benchmark provides a separately packaged blind-test comparison; overlap is not established. Coverage is controlled tunnel conditions, not long-term operating history. Sampling rates and uncertainty need checking per channel, and scale transfer remains a limitation. No archive was downloaded or control-performance claim reproduced.
